name: Gears of Freedom
source:
Elias Ventner arrives at the imposing Arkwright Mansion in search of work, but soon finds himself drawn into something far more complex.

Within its silent halls lies a forbidden wing shrouded in mystery, an eccentric widowed inventor named Silas, and Victor, the mansion’s disciplined and guarded butler. As Elias uncovers fragments of the past, stories of a lost wife, abandoned inventions, and lingering scars, he begins to form bonds that blur the line between duty and desire.

Caught between grief, loyalty, and longing, Elias must ultimately decide: will he help Silas piece his life back together, or follow Victor toward the promise of a fresh start?

In a world of steam and steel, even broken gears can turn again.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/4604880/Gears_of_Freedom/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
伊莱亚斯·文特纳为谋求差事来到气势恢宏的阿克赖特庄园，却很快发现自己卷入了一场远比想象中错综复杂的漩涡。

在寂静深邃的庄园长廊深处，隐藏着一片谜团重重的禁入侧翼，还住着丧偶的怪人发明家西拉斯，以及严谨克制、戒心重重的管家维克多。随着伊莱亚斯一步步揭开往昔的碎片——亡妻的旧事、废弃的发明与久久未愈的伤痕——他与两人结下的羁绊也开始模糊职责与渴望之间的界限。

徘徊于悲恸、忠诚与眷恋之间的伊莱亚斯，最终必须作出抉择：他是该留下来帮助西拉斯重拾支离破碎的人生，还是追随维克多迈向全新开始的诺言？

在蒸汽与钢铁构筑的世界里，哪怕残破的齿轮，亦能再度转动。

[摘自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/4604880/Gears_of_Freedom/]Steam[/url]]
